set.st: Fred Boyer, a farmer at Dale who feared banks, buried his money in his hogpen and died in January 1909 without telling where. Relatives searched and found a tin box with nearly $7,000 in large gold pieces; it went to a cousin in Detroit. Pin is the Boyer farm on the 1917 plat, not the spot itself.
set.pl: Boyer farm, E part sec 15 T21N R15E, Dale Twp (1917 plat: Geo. Boyer 90 a); link to Fred Boyer's 1909 farm inferred from the surname
pinev: 1917 Outagamie Co plat, Dale Twp: 'Geo. Boyer 90, Clover Leaf Dairy Farm', E part of sec 15 at the sec 14 line; no Fred Boyer (d. Jan 1909), so George is the likely kin holding the farm. Moved from the Dale town point.

src: Atlas of Outagamie County (1917), Dale Twp T21N R15E, p. 47 (Ancestry image 31617_072130-00156)
